import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1000000000;
    static final int MAXN = 15;
    static final int MAXT = 65;
    static char[][] g1 = new char[MAXN+1][MAXN+1];
    static char[][] g2 = new char[MAXN+1][MAXN+1];
    static int[][] dist = new int[MAXN+1][MAXN+1];
    static int[][][] node_id = new int[MAXT+2][MAXN+1][MAXN+1];
    static int id_counter = 1;
    static int[] dy = {-1,1,0,0};
    static int[] dx = {0,0,-1,1};

    static class Edge {
        int u, v;
        long cap, flow;
        Edge(int u, int v, long cap) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static class Dinic {
        int N;
        ArrayList<Edge> E;
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> g;
        int[] d, pt;

        Dinic(int N) {
            this.N = N;
            E = new ArrayList<>();
            g = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) g.add(new ArrayList<>());
            d = new int[N];
            pt = new int[N];
        }

        void add_edge(int u, int v, long cap) {
            if (u == v) return;
            E.add(new Edge(u, v, cap));
            g.get(u).add(E.size() - 1);
            E.add(new Edge(v, u, 0));
            g.get(v).add(E.size() - 1);
        }

        boolean bfs(int S, int T) {
            Arrays.fill(d, N+1);
            d[S] = 0;
            LinkedList<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(S);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                if (u == T) break;
                for (int idx : g.get(u)) {
                    Edge e = E.get(idx);
                    if (e.flow < e.cap && d[e.v] > d[e.u] + 1) {
                        d[e.v] = d[e.u] + 1;
                        q.add(e.v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return d[T] != N+1;
        }

        long dfs(int u, int T, long flow) {
            if (u == T || flow == 0) return flow;
            for (; pt[u] < g.get(u).size(); ++pt[u]) {
                int idx = g.get(u).get(pt[u]);
                Edge e = E.get(idx);
                Edge oe = E.get(idx ^ 1);
                if (d[e.v] == d[e.u] + 1) {
                    long amt = e.cap - e.flow;
                    if (flow != -1 && amt > flow) amt = flow;
                    long pushed = dfs(e.v, T, amt);
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.flow += pushed;
                        oe.flow -= pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long max_flow(int S, int T) {
            long total = 0;
            while (bfs(S, T)) {
                Arrays.fill(pt, 0);
                long flow;
                while ((flow = dfs(S, T, -1)) > 0) {
                    total += flow;
                }
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        // read g1
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                g1[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
            }
        }

        // initialize node_id
        for (int time = 0; time <= t+1; ++time) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                    node_id[time][i][j] = id_counter++;
                }
            }
        }

        int source = 0;
        int sink = id_counter;
        id_counter++;

        // read g2
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                g2[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
            }
        }

        // BFS from 'Z'
        dist = new int[MAXN+1][MAXN+1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) Arrays.fill(dist[i], -1);

        ArrayList<int[]> q = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (g1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    q.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    dist[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        int pos = 0;
        while (pos < q.size()) {
            int[] cur = q.get(pos++);
            int uy = cur[0], ux = cur[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int vy = uy + dy[d];
                int vx = ux + dx[d];
                if (vy >= 1 && vy <= n && vx >= 1 && vx <= n && g1[vy][vx] != 'Y' && dist[vy][vx] == -1) {
                    dist[vy][vx] = dist[uy][ux] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{vy, vx});
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (dist[i][j] == -1 || dist[i][j] > t) dist[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }

        Dinic dinic = new Dinic(id_counter); // total nodes = id_counter

        // source edges
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                char c = g1[i][j];
                if (c >= '1' && c <= '9') {
                    dinic.add_edge(source, node_id[0][i][j], c - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        // time edges
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (g1[i][j] == 'Y' || g1[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                    int vy = i + dy[d];
                    int vx = j + dx[d];
                    if (vy >= 1 && vy <= n && vx >= 1 && vx <= n && g1[vy][vx] != 'Y' && g1[vy][vx] != 'Z') {
                        for (int x = 0; x < t; ++x) {
                            if (dist[vy][vx] >= x+1 && dist[i][j] > x) {
                                dinic.add_edge(node_id[x][i][j], node_id[x+1][vy][vx], 1000);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // sink edges
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (g1[i][j] == 'Y' || g1[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                char c = g2[i][j];
                if (c >= '1' && c <= '9') {
                    int cap = c - '0';
                    for (int x = 0; x <= t; ++x) {
                        dinic.add_edge(node_id[x][i][j], node_id[t+1][i][j], cap);
                    }
                    dinic.add_edge(node_id[t+1][i][j], sink, cap);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dinic.max_flow(source, sink));
        sc.close();
    }
}
